title: Even or odd
statement: Read a whole number. Print even if it is even, otherwise odd.
io_spec: Input: one whole number. Output: the word even or odd.
hints: SAMPLE: number % 2 is the remainder after dividing by 2.
SAMPLE: an even number leaves remainder 0. Use if and else.
solution_approach: SAMPLE: check number % 2 == 0 with if/else and print the matching word.
